annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they're sitting somewhere feeling ashamed, maybe dreading hearing from me
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd rather reach out first with a short message and give them room

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they figured I'd be furious
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they figured I'd be furious, and that's why they've gone quiet
annotations.ce_supportive_use: pass along a note saying I'm open to hearing their side

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they might think they did nothing wrong
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Maybe they assumed the job was cancelled
annotations.ce_supportive_use: they deserve a chance to clear it up

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they might already be carrying guilt about letting me down
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: If something awful happened to them, they might already be carrying guilt
annotations.ce_supportive_use: send word that I'm not holding a grudge
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Piling a formal process on top wouldn't help anyone move on

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they're hoping I'll never mention it
annotations.ce_supportive_use: ask them directly and calmly, so they don't feel ambushed

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they think I'm already out for revenge
annotations.ce_supportive_use: write to them, keep it gentle, and see if they'd meet me halfway

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they may feel cornered by a formal review
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: If they're proud, they may feel cornered by a formal review
annotations.ce_supportive_use: reach out quietly instead and tell them I figure they had their reasons

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they believed their share was owed no matter what
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: from some arrangement I wasn't clear on
annotations.ce_supportive_use: a talk could sort out the misunderstanding kindly

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: them feeling embarrassed and not wanting to face me
annotations.ce_supportive_use: tell them I'm more disappointed than angry, and that I'd listen

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They probably expect me to go after them hard
annotations.ce_supportive_use: surprise them with patience, a simple message saying I hope they're okay
